data.name: Star Vikings Forever
data.detailed_description:
Características

  • Unique Puzzle/RPG Gameplay - Based on teamwork and chain reactions
  • Procedurally-Generated Puzzles - For endless replayability
  • 8+ Hours of Story Mode - Packed with colorful characters and humorous dialog
  • New Game Plus Mode - Brings additional puzzles and gameplay
  • Six Classes - Each with unique, upgradeable skills
  • HATS!!! - Craft special hats and use special items to gain additional boosts
  • Steam Leaderboard Integration - Compete with your friends for the high score!
  • Sssssecrets - Hidden levels and crazy unlockables
  • Soundtrack - Head bangin’ beats by Raphael Müller!


Acerca do jogo

Build Your Strategy. Squash Space Snails. Be a Star Viking.

In Star Vikings Forever you will build your team of spacefaring Vikings to take on the evil scourge of intergalactic snails in a fun and nearly endless stream of challenging puzzles.

Best Indie at Google Play Best of 2017, Finalist at the Google Play Indie Games Festival, Winner for "Best Game Design" at the Brazilian Independent Games Festival, and “Most Offensive Game Ever” at the Space Snails Game Conference. Star Vikings Forever is a humorous Puzzle/RPG developed by the award-winning creators of Chroma Squad, Dungeonland, and Relic Hunters Zero.

Position your team of uniquely built Vikings to strategically attack enemies, and clear the board. Enemies aren’t the brightest, and will attack each other whenever they are attacked. This creates a very satisfying chain-combo system, where you can wipe entire boards with a few moves to clear a path to advance to the next stage, or to complete a specific objective.

Take your time and strategize, or for faster paced combat, make multiple moves simultaneously. Puzzles are procedurally generated, allowing for unique and nonlinear challenges every time. Each character has a standard melee attack, along with a special ability attack that will send snails crying home to their shells. Each special ability is unique to their class and provides an additional layer of strategy in solving puzzles.

Star Vikings’ unique gameplay is packed full of content, and will turn even your non-gamer grandma into a hardcore min-maxing machine by the time the credits roll!

reviews.review:
Star Vikings Forever is an imaginative blend of turn-based strategy, puzzle solving, and light RPG progression that manages to turn a deliberately ridiculous premise into a surprisingly thoughtful tactical experience. Developed by Rogue Snail and published by Akupara Games, it sends a crew of spacefaring Vikings into battle against an army of intergalactic snails. That setup immediately establishes the game's playful personality, but underneath the cartoon humor is a clever combat system built around positioning, teamwork, and exploiting enemy behavior.

The most distinctive element is its chain-reaction combat. Players position their Vikings and attack enemies across compact puzzle-like battlefields, but defeating opponents through raw damage is rarely the most interesting solution. When attacked, enemies can retaliate in ways that cause them to strike other enemies, allowing a carefully planned action to trigger a sequence of attacks across the board. Setting up one move that causes several opponents to effectively destroy one another is extremely satisfying. This turns each encounter into a problem of efficiency, where understanding positioning is often more valuable than simply having powerful characters.

The game also gives players control over the pace of combat. Someone who enjoys methodical puzzle solving can carefully examine the board before committing to actions, while more confident players can execute multiple moves simultaneously and create a faster flow. This flexibility prevents the turn-based structure from feeling unnecessarily slow. The basic rules are approachable, yet finding the most efficient combinations gives the system enough depth to reward experimentation and forward planning.

Procedurally generated puzzles are another important part of the experience. Changing arrangements mean that players frequently need to reconsider their tactics instead of memorizing one fixed sequence for every encounter. This contributes substantially to replayability and works well with a combat system centered on recognizing opportunities. Procedural generation does mean that some encounters can feel more interesting than others, and particularly demanding players may occasionally prefer the precision of fully handcrafted puzzles. Even so, the randomized structure generally complements the game's focus on improvisation.

RPG progression adds another layer without overwhelming the puzzle mechanics. Six different classes are available, with each possessing its own upgradeable abilities. Characters have conventional melee attacks alongside special attacks that can dramatically change how a particular board is approached. Party composition therefore matters because different abilities create different opportunities for manipulating enemy positions and setting up combinations. Upgrading these abilities gradually expands the player's tactical options rather than merely increasing numerical statistics.

There is also an amusing equipment component built around crafting hats and acquiring special items for additional bonuses. Hats fit naturally with the deliberately silly presentation, but they still serve a practical progression purpose. Hidden stages and unusual unlockables provide additional incentives to explore the game's systems. These features keep progression entertaining without transforming the experience into an inventory-heavy RPG, which is an appropriate decision considering that tactical puzzles remain the main attraction.

The story mode offers more than eight hours of content according to its feature description and uses colorful characters and humorous dialogue to maintain a consistently light atmosphere. The writing is intentionally absurd rather than emotionally dramatic, and the conflict between Vikings and space snails is treated with exactly the level of seriousness one would expect. The comedy will naturally depend on personal taste, but it gives the campaign an identity that separates it from more conventional tactical games. The colorful, hand-drawn cartoon aesthetic reinforces this tone while keeping battlefields visually readable.

Replay value extends beyond the primary campaign. New Game Plus introduces additional puzzles and provides another opportunity to make use of developed characters and accumulated tactical knowledge. Leaderboards encourage score-oriented players to optimize their performance, while procedurally generated challenges help ensure that repeated sessions are not completely identical. Secrets and unlockables provide further goals for completionists. The soundtrack by Raphael Müller is another enjoyable part of the presentation, matching the game's energetic and eccentric personality.

The main weakness is that nearly everything depends on how much the player enjoys the central puzzle-combo mechanic. The RPG systems provide useful variety but are deliberately streamlined, so anyone expecting extensive exploration, complicated equipment management, or a sprawling narrative RPG may find the experience comparatively narrow. Procedural encounters can also fluctuate in quality, and the humorous tone may become repetitive for players who prefer more serious storytelling. Nevertheless, these limitations rarely undermine what the game is specifically trying to accomplish.

Steam Deck compatibility requires some qualification. Star Vikings Forever does not currently have a confirmed official Steam Deck compatibility classification that establishes it as Steam Deck Verified or Playable. The game does support Linux and has relatively modest technical demands, but it only lists partial controller support. Consequently, it should be regarded as having unconfirmed Steam Deck compatibility rather than being presented as officially Verified. Players intending to use it primarily on the handheld should be prepared for the possibility of control adjustments or other compatibility considerations.

Overall, Star Vikings Forever succeeds by building a deceptively strategic game around an intentionally silly concept. Its chain reactions provide the mechanical centerpiece, while six character classes, upgradeable abilities, procedural puzzles, crafting, secrets, New Game Plus, and leaderboards give that foundation enough variety to remain interesting. It is particularly well suited to players who enjoy solving tactical problems and discovering increasingly efficient combinations without committing to an extremely complicated strategy game. The colorful humor draws attention, but the intelligent interaction between positioning and enemy behavior is ultimately what makes the experience memorable.

Rating: 8/10
